# Move your business email to Microsoft 365.

Bring existing mailboxes into a manageable Microsoft 365 environment. We agree what is moving, how the change will happen and what needs checking afterwards.

[Talk through your needs ↗](https://ostechnology.uk/services/business/microsoft-365-migration#contact)

## Start by understanding what is already there.

Moving email starts with the current provider, domain ownership and the accounts people use each day. We establish the mailboxes, aliases, shared addresses and access involved before agreeing the work.

Tell us about existing messages and folders, calendars, contacts and any applications that send email for the business. What can be transferred depends on the source system and access available; your proposal identifies the data and configuration included.

If several businesses or domains are involved, we discuss how they should be organised and who needs access. Consolidation should make administration clearer while keeping business identities understandable.

### Access matters.

We need to establish access to the current email service, domain DNS and the destination environment. Missing access or uncertain ownership needs resolving before the move can be scheduled.

## Agree the move and check the result.

### Scope the migration

Record the users, domains, data and devices included. Explain the required subscriptions, migration work and any dependencies or limitations found during discovery.

### Prepare Microsoft 365

Configure the agreed accounts, licences and access controls. Confirm how people will sign in and which administrative and recovery details your business needs to retain.

### Agree the cutover

Plan the timing, user communication and DNS changes together. Discuss the expected interruption and the options available if an issue is found before proceeding.

### Check after the move

Check sending and receiving, the agreed migrated data, shared mailbox access and device connections. Confirm any outstanding actions and the support arrangements afterwards.

## A estimate based on your existing setup.

Migration effort varies with the source provider, mailbox count, data and access. We provide a tailored estimate and identify subscriptions separately.

Existing services should only be retired once the agreed checks are complete and any retention requirements have been discussed.
